title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 03:00 UTC on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日 03:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 03:00 UTC. The 03:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 03:59; hour-end 0.00/0Z). No trailing incomplete hour is published after 03:59. Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-09-22 02:48 UTC; label 2Z; last-180 window from 01:00 UTC). Published-window maximum is 2.00 (02:48 UTC; label 2Z). Window start 2026-09-21 22:02 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 03:00 UTC。03:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 03:59，時段末 0.00／0Z）。03:59 之後尚無未收滿的下一整點時段。近 180 筆最大 2.00（最先見於 2026-09-22 02:48 UTC；標籤 2Z；近 180 筆窗自 01:00 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 2.00（02:48 UTC；標籤 2Z）。窗起點 2026-09-21 22:02 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (03:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 03:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour stays near quiet (peak 0.33/0P around 03:33–03:44 and 03:57) and ends at 0.00/0Z at 03:59.
